newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Chem 96/97 group net seen down 82%--paper.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Chem 96/97 group net seen down 82%--paper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Chemical Corp is expected to suffer an 82 percent fall in its group net profit in the year to next March 31 due to a fall in petrochemical product prices and a rise in prices of materials, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said its 1996/97 group net profit is expected to be about four billion yen.
Mitsubishi Chemical posted an actual group net profit of 22.53 billion yen in 1995/96.
The paper said the company would not post any parent net profit in 1996/97, against its 1995/96 parent net profit of 8.60 billion yen.
Mitsubishi Chemical was not immediately available for comment.
